messages:
elena_cs: Morning team — kicking off onboarding for Cinder Labs (account: cinder). Primary goals: get model into staging, validate latency/cost targets, and hand over runbook to their Platform team. Looping in @sam_pm and @devon_eng for stakeholder alignment.

sam_pm: thanks Elena. Can you confirm the target launch window? client asked for a pilot demo in ~30 days. Also adding product analytics contact @tess_enablement for success criteria.

elena_cs: yes 30 days is the ask. High-level success criteria I proposed: 1) 95th pct latency <= 250ms for 1k token sessions, 2) average per-1k-token infra cost down 20% vs POC, 3) auth + audit logs enabled and verified, 4) internal QA sign-off.

devon_eng: noted. We need their VPC peering and production access to test KV cache behavior. Dev question: do they want private (VPC) or Dedicated for pilot? that changes infra timeline.

elena_cs: Cinder prefers private deployment behind their VPC for data rules. I've requested network contacts; still waiting.

tess_enablement: I can run two enablement sessions: (A) developer integration walkthrough, (B) ops runbook + SLA expectations. Propose week4 for ops runbook review so we can incorporate any infra learnings.

priya_sales: flagging renewal timeline — contract renewal window opens in ~11 months. If pilot shows cost savings we should propose Dedicated/committed pricing to lock them in. Also small renewal risk: procurement asked for SOC2 audit details, so we should ensure compliance artifacts are accessible.

onboard-bot: onboarding-epic created: CINDER-ONB-210 (owner: elena_cs). Checklist items seeded.

elena_cs: sharing first-pass timeline and owners:```
Week 0 (this week): stakeholder intro, access requests (owner: elena_cs)
Week 1: env access, model selection, basic latency baseline (owner: devon_eng)
Week 2: KV cache + batching config, cost profiling (owner: devon_eng)
Week 3: integration testing + security validation (owner: devon_eng / tess_enablement)
Week 4: enablement, runbook handoff, pilot demo (owner: tess_enablement / elena_cs)
```

elena_cs: immediate asks: 1) @sam_pm please confirm product analytics contact, 2) @devon_eng please add VPC requirements to the epic, 3) @priya_sales send SOC2 artifact link to Cinder procurement.

sam_pm: pinging @maria_analytics (cc in their org). I'll DM the contact and paste here when confirmed.

devon_eng: will add VPC checklist and expected IP ranges to CINDER-ONB-210 by EOD. Also calling out potential blocker: their initial traffic profile shows many short sessions which can hurt batching efficiency — might affect cost target.

tess_enablement: I'll draft a 45-min dev walkthrough + 30-min ops runbook session. Proposed dates: Week3 Thu + Week4 Tue. OK with everyone? :calendar:

priya_sales: I'll upload SOC2 docs to the shared folder and ping procurement today. Also pricing team is ready to model Dedicated savings if pilot metrics look good.

elena_cs: perfect. Closing with immediate next steps: 1) schedule intro call with all stakeholders (I'll send invite for tomorrow 10am PT), 2) owners to update the epic by EOD, 3) Tess to post enablement dates. Any major objections or missing stakeholders? :thumbsup:

sam_pm: :thumbsup:

devon_eng: no objections. Will add a note about potential cost variance and mitigation (prefix caching + dynamic batching).

tess_enablement: :thumbsup: I'll post calendar invites once Maria confirms analytics contact.

elena_cs: thanks all — I'll follow up in the epic and post a brief one-pager to the shared drive after the intro call.
